text: a doleful lamentation: Heb. with a lamentation of lamentations | turning away he hath divided: Or, instead of restoring
Prophesy ye not: Or, prophesy not, as they prophesy | Prophesy: Heb. drop, etc.
straightened: Or, shortened | uprightly?: Heb. upright
Even of late: Heb. yesterday | with the garment: Heb. over against a garment
walking in the spirit and falsehood: Or, walk with the wind, and lie falsely
